text:
nia.docs: Heads-up: UX review flagged confusion in quickstart around fetch. folks copy sample-app and hit \"fetch is not defined\" on Node 16.
matt.sdk: thanks — we need clear default strategy. my proposal: SDK should prefer globalThis.fetch when present, but export an explicit `setFetchImplementation(fetchImpl)` helper so apps can inject undici or other shims without monkeypatching globals.
ravi.infra: +1. In infra we prefer not to rely on global mutation (setGlobalDispatcher). injection API avoids bundler surprises for ESM/CJS. Also mention node versions and recommend undici@5 for node <18.
kelly.prod: onboarding needs a copy-paste snippet. could we provide 3 single-line options: edge, modern node, legacy node? e.g. Edge (no-op), Node >=18 (no-op), Node <18 (install undici shim).
matt.sdk: draft quick examples I want to include:```js
// ESM app (Node <18)
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
import { setFetchImplementation } from '@redwood/inference'
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
```js
// CJS app (Node <18)
const { fetch: undiciFetch } = require('undici')
const { setFetchImplementation } = require('@redwood/inference')
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
nia.docs: those are great. please also include a tiny fallback helper for users who don't want to change app code:```js
// quick global shim (use only if you know the app won't be bundled)
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
if (!globalThis.fetch) globalThis.fetch = undiciFetch
```
ravi.infra: we should call out caveats: undici's streaming/abort semantics differ slightly from Fetch standard in some versions. warn about retries + streaming bodies. important for auth tokens with refresh on 401.
matt.sdk: i'm adding a small internal wrapper that normalizes Response-like shape and exposes a RetryOptions hook. SDK will not assume retries at fetch-level; we'll implement idempotent retries for GET/HEAD only, and provide a pluggable retry handler for POSTs that are safe.
kelly.prod: also add a troubleshooting table to quickstart: errors and one-line fixes. e.g. \"TypeError: fetch is not a function\" -> paste shim or call setFetchImplementation; \"stream aborted mid-response\" -> try undici@latest or switch to global fetch on edge.
nia.docs: note on typings: export a FetchLike type alias (`type FetchLike = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>`) and attach it to exported setFetchImplementation signature for TS users.
matt.sdk: will do. for ESM/CJS interop sample-apps we should show both `import` and `require` patterns and mention bundlers: avoid `typeof window === 'undefined'` checks in library code; rely on detect function instead: `hasGlobalFetch()` that returns boolean.
ravi.infra: CI change: add node 14/16/18/20 matrix to catch these edge cases. I bumped one of the runner images and found a failing integration for streaming tests. tagging @ci-bot to re-run.
ci-bot: ci:retest requested by @ravi.infra — queued.
kelly.prod: one more ask: include a tiny paragraph in the console onboarding that says which runtimes need action. keeps support volume down.
matt.sdk: plan of action: 1) add setFetchImplementation + hasGlobalFetch helpers 2) export FetchLike typedef 3) example ESM/CJS shims in quickstart + sample-apps 4) internal retry wrapper with opt-out hooks 5) docs troubleshooting table. I'll open a draft PR today.
nia.docs: i'll take the quickstart copy and incorporate the table. Thanks everyone.
ci-bot: ci:tests v1.4 running — currently 2 failing (http-client-stream-compat). matt.sdk: can you look when you open the PR?
matt.sdk: will do. likely need to normalize body streams for older undici versions.
